candidates.source_authority: 1979 President's Commission report on Three Mile Island, page 97, catalogued by Wikimedia Commons
candidates.creator_credit: John G. Kemeny et al (commission report); current Wikimedia file was retouched by a Commons user
candidates.scene: Control panel of TMI-2 with maintenance tags obscuring one valve-indicator light
candidates.rights_evidence: Commons item asserts public domain based on U.S. federal-government work (17 USC 105); retouched Commons revision needs independent identity and contribution review

rows.issue: Publisher credits NRC figure; federal commission catalog is a plausible photograph of the same control panel, not an authenticated binary match to the UCS Figure 4. Do not upscale or silently replace photographic treatment.

candidates.source_authority: United States Coast Guard official historical article by Dr David S Rosen
candidates.creator_credit: U.S. Coast Guard (article's credited historic photographs)
candidates.scene: 1946 aftermath, debris and remains of Scotch Cap Lighthouse, with distinct images from bluff and aerial viewpoints
candidates.rights_evidence: Official Coast Guard photo attribution; individual asset copyright/license and binary identity not independently cleared

rows.issue: Official source distinguishes bluff photograph from aerial aftermath and pre-1946 images. Confirm scene and original image identity before any replacement; 1964-era NOAA scene is not acceptable.

candidates.source_authority: State Archives of Florida, Florida Memory, Department of Commerce collection
candidates.scene: Aerial view of old and new Sunshine Skyway bridges
candidates.rights_evidence: Catalog identifies creator and archival holding; web catalog rights field is not clear affirmative commercial republication license; seek item-level confirmation

rows.issue: Historical editorial alternative for the old/new bridge chronology ONLY: a 1989 aerial cannot stand in for a photograph of the May 9, 1980 collision, or be described as the original St Pete Catalyst image.

workflow.conditional_sizing: Use min(native_width,960); preserve full-frame ratio, no enlargement; if dimensions unknown, block sizing and binary handling.
workflow.caching: Before any first-party WordPress caching, prove original displayed failure, exact artwork identity, rights/credit, hash, dimensions, editorial crop/ALT and visual before/after in a separate non-production staging environment.
workflow.wire_bytes: Compare cold, cache-disabled fully-scrolled page image encoded transfer bytes for same 66 post cohort, browser viewport, DPR, original content and decoded-image coverage. Baseline and candidate bytes are null today; never use stored WordPress bytes as wire bytes.
